INSERT INTO order_stage_assignments (order_id, stage_id, assignee_id, assignee_name)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (order_id, stage_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            assignee_id = EXCLUDED.assignee_id,
            assignee_name = EXCLUDED.assignee_name,
            assigned_at = now()
